00062 void PlayBufUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00063 {   
00064     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00065

00086         float* trigSamples = inputs[Trig].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);

00103             if(*loopSamples++ >= 0.5f)

00137 PlayBuf::PlayBuf(Buffer const& buffer, UGen const& rate, UGen const& trigger, UGen const& startPos, UGen const& loop) throw()
00138 {   
00139     // just mix the input ugens, they should be mono
00140     // mix() will just return the original UGen if it has only one channel anyway
00141     
00142     const int numChannels = buffer.getNumChannels();
00143     
00144     if(numChannels > 0 && buffer.size() > 0)
00145     {
00146         initInternal(numChannels);
00147         
00148         UGen startPosChecked = startPos.mix();
00149         generateFromProxyOwner(new PlayBufUGenInternal(buffer, rate.mix(), trigger.mix(), startPosChecked, loop.mix()));
00150 
00151         for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00152         {
00153             internalUGens[i]->initValue(buffer.getSample(i, startPosChecked.getValue(0)));
00154         }
00155     }
00156     
00157     // unnessecary the default constructor should have this in place
00158 //  else
00159 //  {
00160 //      initInternal(1);
00161 //      internalUGens[0] = getNullInternal();
00162 //  }
00163 }
